examples.text_en: He can play the bassoon very well.
examples.text_zh: 他巴松管吹得很好。

examples.text_en: The bassoon makes a low and deep sound.
examples.text_zh: 巴松管发出低沉的声音。

examples.text_en: Please baste the two pieces before the last step.
examples.text_zh: 请在最后一步之前把这两片粗缝起来。

examples.text_en: She will baste them together and then she will stop.
examples.text_zh: 她会把它们粗缝在一起，然后就停下来。

examples.text_en: He made a large batch of food for the group.
examples.text_zh: 他为这群人做了一大批食物。

examples.text_en: The next batch will be ready in a few days.
examples.text_zh: 下一批几天后就准备好了。

examples.text_en: The bather stood still in the deep water.
examples.text_zh: 那位入浴者一动不动地站在深水里。

examples.text_en: The bather went back to the house for a rest.
examples.text_zh: 那个游泳者回到屋里休息。

examples.text_en: The sad ending felt bathetic after such joy.
examples.text_zh: 在如此欢乐之后，这个悲伤的结局显得矫揉造作。

examples.text_en: His speech turned bathetic near the very end.
examples.text_zh: 他的演讲在最后变得空洞煽情。

examples.text_en: He wore a soft bathrobe after the shower.
examples.text_zh: 洗完澡后他穿上了一件柔软的浴衣。

examples.text_en: She packed her bathrobe into the small bag.
examples.text_zh: 她把浴衣装进了小包里。

examples.text_en: The man used the baton to lead the music.
examples.text_zh: 那个人用指挥棒引领音乐。

examples.text_en: She held the baton and ran to the next girl.
examples.text_zh: 她握着接力棒跑向那个女孩。

examples.text_en: A full battalion marched through the quiet town.
examples.text_zh: 一整个营的士兵列队穿过安静的小镇。

examples.text_en: The battalion camped near the river that night.
examples.text_zh: 那天夜里，这支部队在河边扎营。

examples.text_en: The field became a bloody battleground that year.
examples.text_zh: 那一年，这片田野成了血腥的战场。

examples.text_en: Farmers later planted crops on that wide battleground.
examples.text_zh: 后来农民在那片宽阔的战场上种起了庄稼。

examples.text_en: She bought a small bauble for her child.
examples.text_zh: 她给孩子买了一个小玩意。

examples.text_en: The bauble looks nice but it is worth nothing.
examples.text_zh: 这个小玩意儿好看，却一文不值。

examples.text_en: The men found bauxite under the hard ground.
examples.text_zh: 人们在这坚硬的地面下发现了铝土矿。

examples.text_en: They use bauxite to make many good things.
examples.text_zh: 他们用铝土矿制造许多好东西。

examples.text_en: The men told bawdy jokes after a few drinks.
examples.text_zh: 喝了几杯之后，那些人讲起了下流的笑话。

examples.text_en: The play was full of bawdy songs and dances.
examples.text_zh: 这出戏里充满了低俗的歌舞。

examples.text_en: We bought fresh fruit at the busy bazaar.
examples.text_zh: 我们在热闹的集市上买了新鲜水果。

examples.text_en: The bazaar opens early every Saturday morning.
examples.text_zh: 这个集市每周六清晨很早就开门。

examples.text_en: The lighthouse beacon guided the ships home.
examples.text_zh: 灯塔的光引导船只回家。

examples.text_en: They lit a beacon on the high hill.
examples.text_zh: 他们在高地上点起了烽火。

examples.text_en: The child held a small bead in her hand.
examples.text_zh: 孩子手里握着一颗小珠子。

examples.text_en: A bead of water ran down her face.
examples.text_zh: 一滴水顺着她的脸流下来。

examples.text_en: She wore a beaded dress to the party.
examples.text_zh: 她穿着一件饰有珠子的连衣裙去参加聚会。

examples.text_en: A beaded curtain hung in the doorway.
examples.text_zh: 门口挂着一串珠帘。

examples.text_en: That dark beak looks very long and hard.
examples.text_zh: 那个深色的鸟嘴看起来又长又硬。

examples.text_en: The long beak can be a very hard thing.
examples.text_zh: 长鸟嘴可以是非常坚硬的东西。

examples.text_en: This soup is made with fresh beancurd and greens.
examples.text_zh: 这道汤是用新鲜豆腐和青菜做的。

examples.text_en: He bought beancurd from the morning market.
examples.text_zh: 他从早市上买了豆腐。

examples.text_en: She wore a beatific smile all through the day.
examples.text_zh: 她一整天都带着幸福的笑容。

examples.text_en: His beatific look told us he was at peace.
examples.text_zh: 他安详的神情告诉我们他内心平静。

examples.text_en: She put the bedclothes on the bed at night.
examples.text_zh: 她夜里把铺盖铺在床上。

examples.text_en: Please bring the bedclothes back before the day ends.
examples.text_zh: 请在一天结束前把铺盖拿回来。

examples.text_en: The beddings are kept in this room.
examples.text_zh: 寝具都收在这个房间里。

examples.text_en: She wants new beddings for the small room.
examples.text_zh: 她想给这个小房间换新寝具。

examples.text_en: They bedeck the hall with flowers every spring.
examples.text_zh: 每年春天，他们用鲜花装饰大厅。

examples.text_en: Workers bedeck the streets before the great festival.
examples.text_zh: 盛大的节日前，工人们装饰了街道。

examples.text_en: She likes to bedizen her room with bright colors.
examples.text_zh: 她喜欢用鲜艳的色彩俗丽地装饰房间。

examples.text_en: They bedizen the bare walls with cheap paint.
examples.text_zh: 他们用廉价的颜料把光秃的墙壁装点得花里胡哨。

examples.text_en: The classroom became a bedlam after the bell.
examples.text_zh: 铃声过后，教室里变得一片喧闹。

examples.text_en: It was bedlam at the station during the storm.
examples.text_zh: 暴风雨期间，车站里一片混乱。

examples.text_en: The dog came home and looked bedraggled.
examples.text_zh: 那狗回到家，看上去浑身泥污。

examples.text_en: Her bedraggled hair was over her face.
examples.text_zh: 她湿透的头发盖在脸上。

examples.text_en: Workers dug down to the solid bedrock.
examples.text_zh: 工人们一直挖到了坚硬的基岩。

examples.text_en: Trust is the bedrock of any good friendship.
examples.text_zh: 信任是任何美好友谊的基础。

examples.text_en: He lives in a small bedsit near the school.
examples.text_zh: 他住在学校附近一间小卧室兼起居室里。

examples.text_en: The bedsit is small but it is a home.
examples.text_zh: 这间卧室兼起居室很小，却是个家。

examples.text_en: A beehive was on the back wall.
examples.text_zh: 一个蜂箱挂在后墙上。

examples.text_en: The beehive is full of life in summer.
examples.text_zh: 夏天蜂箱里充满生机。

examples.text_en: The long question will befuddle the young boy.
examples.text_zh: 这个冗长的问题会把小男孩弄糊涂。

examples.text_en: Too much news can befuddle the best of us.
examples.text_zh: 过多的消息会把我们中最聪明的人也弄糊涂。

examples.text_en: His befuddlement was clear from his blank look.
examples.text_zh: 他茫然的神情清楚地表明了他的迷糊。

examples.text_en: The strange rules caused great befuddlement among us.
examples.text_zh: 这些奇怪的规则让我们十分困惑。

examples.text_en: He tried to beguile the girl with kind words.
examples.text_zh: 他试图用好话诱骗那个女孩。

examples.text_en: They will beguile you if you are too kind.
examples.text_zh: 如果你太善良，他们就会诱骗你。

examples.text_en: He is beholden to the man who helped him.
examples.text_zh: 他感激那个帮助过他的人。

examples.text_en: We are beholden to them for their great help.
examples.text_zh: 我们感谢他们的大力帮助。

examples.text_en: It would behoove you to think before you act.
examples.text_zh: 你最好三思而后行。

examples.text_en: It will behoove us to plan the work today.
examples.text_zh: 我们今天理应把工作安排好。

examples.text_en: The man would belabor the poor boy again.
examples.text_zh: 那人又会痛打那个可怜的男孩。

examples.text_en: He did not mean to belabor the small dog.
examples.text_zh: 他并不是想痛打那只小狗。

examples.text_en: We sent her a belated birthday card.
examples.text_zh: 我们给她寄了一张迟到的生日贺卡。

examples.text_en: His belated apology did little to help.
examples.text_zh: 他迟来的道歉几乎帮不上什么忙。

examples.text_en: He had to belch in front of his friends.
examples.text_zh: 他不得不在朋友们面前打嗝。

examples.text_en: Do not belch at the table, young man.
examples.text_zh: 年轻人，别在饭桌上打嗝。

examples.text_en: Enemy soldiers beleaguer the city for many months.
examples.text_zh: 敌军围困这座城许多个月。

examples.text_en: Problems beleaguer the small company every year.
examples.text_zh: 问题每年都困扰着这家小公司。

examples.text_en: His kind face seemed to belie a hard heart.
examples.text_zh: 他和善的脸似乎掩盖着一颗冷酷的心。

examples.text_en: Her words belie the hate in her heart.
examples.text_zh: 她的话与心中的恨意并不相符。

examples.text_en: Do not belittle the work of the young man.
examples.text_zh: 不要轻视这个年轻人的工作。

examples.text_en: She would belittle him in front of everyone.
examples.text_zh: 她常当着大家的面贬低他。

examples.text_en: The bellicose man was always ready to fight.
examples.text_zh: 那个好战的人总是准备打架。

examples.text_en: His bellicose words made the group stop and think.
examples.text_zh: 他好战的话语让这群人停下来思考。

examples.text_en: His belligerence made the meeting very hard.
examples.text_zh: 他的好战态度让会议很难进行。

examples.text_en: The belligerence of the two men was clear.
examples.text_zh: 这两个人的敌意清楚可见。

examples.text_en: He gave a belligerent answer and left the room.
examples.text_zh: 他给了一个好斗的回答，然后离开了房间。

examples.text_en: The belligerent group was ready for a long fight.
examples.text_zh: 这个好战的团体准备好打一场持久战。

examples.text_en: The blacksmith worked the bellows with his hands.
examples.text_zh: 铁匠用手拉动风箱。

examples.text_en: Air from the bellows made the fire burn bright.
examples.text_zh: 风箱送来的空气让火烧得旺起来。

examples.text_en: That state is a bellwether in many elections.
examples.text_zh: 那个州在许多选举中是风向标。

examples.text_en: The company is a bellwether for the local industry.
examples.text_zh: 这家公司是当地行业的风向标。

examples.text_en: He gave me a bemused look and said nothing.
examples.text_zh: 他困惑地看了我一眼，什么也没说。

examples.text_en: The bemused students stared at the strange question.
examples.text_zh: 困惑的学生们盯着那个奇怪的问题。

examples.text_en: The priest gave a quiet benediction at the end.
examples.text_zh: 最后，神父低声做了祝福。

examples.text_en: Her kind words felt like a warm benediction.
examples.text_zh: 她亲切的话语像温暖的祝福。

examples.text_en: The school had a great benefactor for many years.
examples.text_zh: 这所学校多年来有一位了不起的捐助者。

examples.text_en: He was a benefactor to the poor of the town.
examples.text_zh: 他是城里穷人的恩人。

examples.text_en: His daughter was the main beneficiary of the will.
examples.text_zh: 他女儿是遗嘱的主要受益人。

examples.text_en: The charity is a beneficiary of the town fund.
examples.text_zh: 这家慈善机构是镇基金的受惠者。

examples.text_en: A benevolent stranger paid for our meal.
examples.text_zh: 一位好心的陌生人替我们付了饭钱。

examples.text_en: The school was founded by a benevolent lady.
examples.text_zh: 这所学校是由一位慈善的女士创办的。

examples.text_en: They said the change was benign and small.
examples.text_zh: 他们说这个变化是良性的，而且很小。

examples.text_en: He had a benign look and a kind voice.
examples.text_zh: 他神色善良，声音和蔼。

examples.text_en: The father gave his son a final benison.
examples.text_zh: 父亲给了儿子最后的祝福。

examples.text_en: Her parting words were a gentle benison.
examples.text_zh: 她离别的话是一句温柔的祝福。

examples.text_en: The museum received a large bequest from her.
examples.text_zh: 博物馆收到了她的一大笔遗赠。

examples.text_en: He left a small bequest to each of them.
examples.text_zh: 他给他们每人留下了一小笔遗产。

examples.text_en: The man would berate his son for every small thing.
examples.text_zh: 那人会为每件小事严厉责骂儿子。

examples.text_en: She did not want to berate the young boy.
examples.text_zh: 她不想严厉责备那个小男孩。

examples.text_en: She felt bereft after her best friend left.
examples.text_zh: 最好的朋友离开后，她感到失落。

examples.text_en: The town was bereft of trees and shade.
examples.text_zh: 这个小镇缺少树木和荫凉。

examples.text_en: The dog went berserk when it saw the fire.
examples.text_zh: 狗看到火时发了疯。

examples.text_en: He went berserk and broke the wooden door.
examples.text_zh: 他发狂地砸坏了木门。

examples.text_en: He booked a lower berth on the night train.
examples.text_zh: 他在夜班火车上订了一个下铺。

examples.text_en: The ship found a safe berth near the shore.
examples.text_zh: 船在岸边找到了安全的泊位。

examples.text_en: I beseech you to hear my humble request.
examples.text_zh: 我恳求您听一听我卑微的请求。

examples.text_en: They beseech the king for help and food.
examples.text_zh: 他们向国王哀求帮助和食物。

examples.text_en: Money problems beset the family for many years.
examples.text_zh: 经济问题困扰了这个家庭许多年。

examples.text_en: Doubt and fear beset him before the exam.
examples.text_zh: 考试前，疑虑和恐惧困扰着他。

examples.text_en: Her fine manners bespeak a careful upbringing.
examples.text_zh: 她良好的举止表明她受过精心的教养。

examples.text_en: These stone walls bespeak a long history.
examples.text_zh: 这些石墙显示出悠久的历史。

examples.text_en: The soldiers showed bestial cruelty toward the prisoners.
examples.text_zh: 士兵们对囚犯表现出了野兽般的残忍。

examples.text_en: A bestial roar came from behind the trees.
examples.text_zh: 树后传来一声野兽般的吼叫。

examples.text_en: The king will bestow his trust on the young man.
examples.text_zh: 国王会把信任授予这个年轻人。

examples.text_en: They will bestow food and water on the poor.
examples.text_zh: 他们将为穷人施予食物和水。

examples.text_en: Dark clouds betoken a heavy storm tonight.
examples.text_zh: 乌云预示着今晚会有暴风雨。

examples.text_en: A red sky may betoken good weather tomorrow.
examples.text_zh: 红色的天空也许预示着明天天气晴好。

examples.text_en: He will betroth himself to her this year.
examples.text_zh: 他今年会和她订婚。

examples.text_en: They will betroth the young man and woman.
examples.text_zh: 他们会为这个年轻男子和女子定下婚事。

examples.text_en: The many new words will bewilder the boy.
examples.text_zh: 这么多新词会让男孩不知所措。

examples.text_en: Long talks about the plan bewilder most people.
examples.text_zh: 关于这个计划的长篇讨论让大多数人困惑。

examples.text_en: The city streets were bewildering for a visitor.
examples.text_zh: 对游客来说，这座城市的街道令人困惑。

examples.text_en: He faced a bewildering set of choices that day.
examples.text_zh: 那天他面对着一系列令人困惑的选择。

examples.text_en: The bibliophile owns thousands of rare books.
examples.text_zh: 这位藏书家拥有数千本珍本。

examples.text_en: As a true bibliophile, she never lends her books.
examples.text_zh: 作为一个真正的爱书人，她从不外借自己的书。

examples.text_en: The bibulous man used all his money in one night.
examples.text_zh: 那个嗜酒的人一夜之间用光了所有的钱。

examples.text_en: His bibulous ways were the talk of the town.
examples.text_zh: 他嗜酒的作风成了全镇的谈资。

examples.text_en: The country has a bicameral system of law.
examples.text_zh: 这个国家实行两院制的法律体系。

examples.text_en: They want a bicameral form of government.
examples.text_zh: 他们想要两院制的政府形式。

examples.text_en: The two brothers bicker about small things daily.
examples.text_zh: 两兄弟每天为小事斗嘴。

examples.text_en: They bicker over money but stay close friends.
examples.text_zh: 他们为钱争吵，却仍是好朋友。

examples.text_en: The bidding for the painting rose very quickly.
examples.text_zh: 这幅画的出价迅速攀升。

examples.text_en: Several firms joined the bidding for the contract.
examples.text_zh: 几家公司参与了这份合同的投标。

examples.text_en: The town holds a biennial art show.
examples.text_zh: 这个小镇每两年举办一次艺术展。

examples.text_en: This flower is a biennial in most gardens.
examples.text_zh: 这种花在大多数花园里是两年生植物。

examples.text_en: The river will bifurcate just past the bridge.
examples.text_zh: 这条河将在桥过后分叉。

examples.text_en: The path bifurcates near the tall trees.
examples.text_zh: 小路在高大的树木附近分叉。

examples.text_en: The bigot would not listen to any new idea.
examples.text_zh: 那个偏执的人听不进任何新想法。

examples.text_en: A bigot often thinks his own way is best.
examples.text_zh: 盲从的人常认为自己的方式最好。

examples.text_en: His bigoted words made the meeting end early.
examples.text_zh: 他固执己见的话让会议早早结束。

examples.text_en: The bigoted man had no friends at all.
examples.text_zh: 那个偏执的男人一个朋友也没有。

examples.text_en: Education can slowly reduce bigotry in a society.
examples.text_zh: 教育能慢慢减少社会上的偏见。

examples.text_en: His bigotry made him fear people from other lands.
examples.text_zh: 他的偏见使他对来自其他地方的人心怀恐惧。

examples.text_en: The two countries had a bilateral talk last week.
examples.text_zh: 两国上周进行了双边会谈。

examples.text_en: They want a bilateral deal for the new trade.
examples.text_zh: 他们希望就新的贸易达成双边协议。

examples.text_en: The doctor said too much bile upset his stomach.
examples.text_zh: 医生说胆汁过多扰乱了他的胃。

examples.text_en: Anger and bile filled his every word.
examples.text_zh: 他的每句话都充满了愤怒和火气。

examples.text_en: The bilious man had a bad word for all.
examples.text_zh: 那个脾气坏的人对谁都没有好话。

examples.text_en: He gave me a bilious look and said nothing.
examples.text_zh: 他恶狠狠地看了我一眼，什么也没说。

examples.text_en: The dealer tried to bilk the poor woman.
examples.text_zh: 那个商人试图诈骗这位可怜的妇人。

examples.text_en: They bilk tourists with prices that are far too high.
examples.text_zh: 他们用高得离谱的价格欺骗游客。

examples.text_en: A great billow struck the side of the boat.
examples.text_zh: 一个巨浪打在船的一侧。

examples.text_en: Smoke came in a billow from the burning house.
examples.text_zh: 浓烟像巨浪一样从燃烧的房子里涌出。

examples.text_en: We saw billowy clouds above the wide sea.
examples.text_zh: 我们看见广阔的海面上方翻滚的云。

examples.text_en: The fields looked like a billowy green sea.
examples.text_zh: 田野看上去像一片波涛起伏的绿海。

examples.text_en: They will bind the box with a long line.
examples.text_zh: 他们会用长绳把箱子绑起来。

examples.text_en: A good word can bind two friends together.
examples.text_zh: 一句好话能把两个朋友连在一起。

examples.text_en: They play bingo at the church every Friday.
examples.text_zh: 他们每周五在教堂玩宾戈游戏。

examples.text_en: She won a small prize at the bingo last night.
examples.text_zh: 昨晚她在宾戈游戏中赢得了一个小奖品。

examples.text_en: She will study biochemistry at the new school.
examples.text_zh: 她将在新学校学习生物化学。

examples.text_en: Biochemistry is a hard but beautiful science.
examples.text_zh: 生物化学是一门艰难却美丽的科学。

examples.text_en: The biographer gave ten years to that book.
examples.text_zh: 这位传记作者把十年光阴给了那本书。

examples.text_en: She wants to be a biographer one day.
examples.text_zh: 她希望有一天成为传记作者。

examples.text_en: He is writing a biography of a famous painter.
examples.text_zh: 他正在写一位著名画家的传记。

examples.text_en: This biography covers her early life and work.
examples.text_zh: 这本传记讲述了她的早年生活和工作。

examples.text_en: They did a biological study of the small sea.
examples.text_zh: 他们对这片小海域做了生物学研究。

examples.text_en: The biological side of life is hard to see.
examples.text_zh: 生命的生物学一面很难看见。

examples.text_en: The biosphere is the home of all life.
examples.text_zh: 生物圈是一切生命的家园。

examples.text_en: We must keep the biosphere safe for our children.
examples.text_zh: 我们必须为孩子们保护好生物圈。

examples.text_en: This biotech company is doing very well.
examples.text_zh: 这家生物技术公司经营得很好。

examples.text_en: He works in biotech and loves his job.
examples.text_zh: 他在生物技术行业工作，热爱自己的职业。

examples.text_en: A man is a biped that can walk and run.
examples.text_zh: 人是能够行走和奔跑的两足动物。

examples.text_en: Most bipeds can stand and walk quite well.
examples.text_zh: 大多数两足动物都能很好地站立和行走。

examples.text_en: Humans are bipedal and walk on two legs.
examples.text_zh: 人类是两足的，用两条腿行走。

examples.text_en: Some dinosaurs were bipedal and very fast.
examples.text_zh: 有些恐龙是两足的，跑得很快。

examples.text_en: The yellow bird sang inside its small birdcage.
examples.text_zh: 黄色的小鸟在它的小鸟笼里歌唱。

examples.text_en: He cleaned the birdcage every Sunday morning.
examples.text_zh: 他每个星期天早上都清理鸟笼。

examples.text_en: That small town is the birthplace of the king.
examples.text_zh: 那个小镇是这位国王的诞生地。

examples.text_en: He went back to his birthplace after many years.
examples.text_zh: 多年之后他回到了自己的诞生地。

examples.text_en: The bishop spoke to the crowd after the service.
examples.text_zh: 仪式结束后，主教对人群讲话。

examples.text_en: A kind bishop visited our school last spring.
examples.text_zh: 去年春天，一位和善的主教访问了我们学校。

examples.text_en: A bison is big and strong and very fast.
examples.text_zh: 野牛又大又壮，而且跑得很快。

examples.text_en: The bison can run over the long field.
examples.text_zh: 野牛能在长长的田野上奔跑。

examples.text_en: They put bitumen on the road to make it hard.
examples.text_zh: 他们把沥青铺在路上，使它变硬。

examples.text_en: Bitumen is a dark and very hard thing.
examples.text_zh: 沥青是一种又黑又硬的东西。

examples.text_en: The club used a blackball to reject the newcomer.
examples.text_zh: 俱乐部用反对票拒绝了这位新来者。

examples.text_en: Members gave him the blackball without any discussion.
examples.text_zh: 会员们没有讨论就投票反对他。

examples.text_en: He tried to use blackmail to get the money.
examples.text_zh: 他试图用勒索来弄到那笔钱。

examples.text_en: Blackmail is a bad way to make a living.
examples.text_zh: 勒索是一种糟糕的谋生方式。

examples.text_en: You should blanch the vegetables before freezing them.
examples.text_zh: 冷冻蔬菜之前，你应该先把它们焯一下。

examples.text_en: Fear made her face blanch in the dark room.
examples.text_zh: 恐惧使她在这间暗室里面色发白。

examples.text_en: She ignored his blandishment and walked away.
examples.text_zh: 她没理会他的甜言蜜语，转身走了。

examples.text_en: Their blandishment could not change his firm decision.
examples.text_zh: 他们的奉承改变不了他坚定的决定。
